title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 7: Requiem of the Golden Witch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The seventh arc of a murder-mystery saga set on an island owned by the wealthy Ushiromiya family. The witch Bernkastel places the detective Will Wright and the family heir Lion on her board to answer who killed Beatrice, the 'Golden Witch'; the arc revisits patriarch Kinzo's first meeting with a young Beatrice and offers solutions to the earlier games, suggesting that the 'magic' comes from human longing and minds (Yen Press blurb, ANN).
life_message: Truth matters, but so does the love and pain behind the stories people tell to survive.
